fields.description: Optional. Pick a provider to skip typing the provider/ prefix in Model ID. Leave empty if Model ID already includes the provider.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: LiteLLM model identifier. With a Provider linked, pick or type just the model (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6); otherwise use provider/model form, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6, openai/gpt-4.1, ollama/llama3.1
fields.label: Model ID

fields.description: Max input tokens. Auto-detected from the model on save when left empty; override if your provider differs. 0 = unknown.
fields.label: Context Window

fields.description: API key for the provider named in the Model ID. Leave empty for local servers (Ollama, LM Studio) that don't require authentication.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Optional. Override the provider's default endpoint, e.g. for a self-hosted Ollama (http://localhost:11434) or a proxy.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Optional JSON object passed to the model (e.g. {"temperature": 0.2, "max_tokens": 1024})
fields.label: Params
